title: feat: add metadata customization overlay, package upgrade, and marketplace protocols
body:
- [x] Analyze current metadata-related protocols (manifest, package-registry, metadata-persistence, metadata-loader, plugin-versioning)
- [x] Identify gaps in metadata loading from plugin packages, customer customization persistence, and package upgrade flows
- [x] Create Metadata Customization Layer protocol (`kernel/metadata-customization.zod.ts`) - overlay tracking, 3-way merge for package upgrades
- [x] Create Package Upgrade Protocol (`kernel/package-upgrade.zod.ts`) - upgrade plan, snapshot, rollback, validation
- [x] Create Marketplace Protocol (`cloud/marketplace.zod.ts`) - listing, publishing, review, search for plugin marketplace
- [x] Enhance MetadataRecordSchema with `packageId` and `managedBy` fields for package ownership tracking
- [x] Enhance PackageStatusEnum with `upgrading` status and InstalledPackageSchema with version tracking
- [x] Add tests for all new protocols (60 new tests, 187 test files, 4972 tests all passing)
- [x] Update kernel/index.ts and cloud/index.ts barrel exports
- [x] Move marketplace protocol from kernel/ to cloud/ per review feedback
- [x] Run code review and security checks
